originality.rationale: The original self-review distinguishes Iwasaki’s local statement at epsilon=0 and published determinant factor from its additional global unramifiedness proof; the completed line’s two-point classification was not located in checked sources.
residual_risks: Iwasaki Appendix A.1 already prints the full determinant with both roots. The new result is close to an elementary consequence once the global Cox-rank condition is checked; an unstated but intended or already-known globalization remains a priority risk.
Semantic searches and full-text inspection of two primary works are not an exhaustive proof of priority; an unindexed note or an earlier version might already verify global unramifiedness.
